'''Kelsh''' was a bronze-colored metal used in many industries, and was often used to decorate clothing. [[Shaara]] once used it to disguise herself as a droid for an entertainment show.<ref name="Shaara">{{StoryCite|story=Shaara and the Sarlacc: The Skiff Guard's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
